page.layout: One block of Latin verse, full width, with the running head at the top and the catchword at the foot right. The right margin shows only show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed.

p.i: Sceptraq; Francorum raptori tradere IBERO, Cunctaq; terrarum PAPAE submittere habenis?

Nec satis impune est scelera haec committier; ipso Instinctore Deo fieri, numenq; supernum Iratum posse haud alia ratione moneri Unanimes uno ore canunt, scelerumq; magistros Et percussores Regum, calumq; mereri, Deberiq; Deo toties repetuntq; docentq; Indigetesq; vocant Regumq; Ducumq; latrones.

Quae m[?]nt vera equidem nosti Rex maxime nosti, Si meminisse voles, neque longe exempla petenda: Intus habes, nam tu, vel nemo, conscius horum Esse potes, si vel dentis, vel cetera vita Tempora perpendas; vix, nec vix tutus in aula Nunc hodie es, licet ipse sacros amplectere PAPAS, Et veluti primus dicaris filius esse.

Praeteriti memor esto, animoq; futura revolve, Si potes, atque tibi sit LVSITANICVS HEROS Perpetuo exemplo. Quis enim maiore adamant[?] Progeniem hanc zelo, similiq; affecit honore? Qua mercede? iacet Regno spoliatus anito[?], Et procul a patria peregrinis casuq;[?] in oris Consilio IVDAITA[?] tuo deceptus & arte. Haec tenebrarum[?] merces, tantiq; fauoris Pramia sunt sceleratae lues, hac gratia Regi Reddita pro meritis. Sed quemnam seruit in usum Haec dixisse tibi toties, eademq; referre, Si mens certa manet tristes renocare Sinones, Harpyiasq; animarum antiquas reddere sedes, Atq; uterum innumeris Regnum obiectare periclis? Quid iuuat ad surdas facere irrita verba procellas,

page.notes: The right margin carries only show-through from the reverse page (faint mirrored letters and marks), not printed notes, so none are transcribed. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "m[?]nt" in the first line of the second stanza is unclear; "adamant" is cut off at the line end; "anito" and "casuq;" are uncertain; "IVDAITA" is probably IVDAICA, left as the scan appears; "tenebrarum" is uncertain. The word "Et" at the foot right is a catchword.
